---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever you build or change any page of the BurgerKhan website.
---

1. The brand is BurgerKhan, a smash-burger delivery kitchen in Lahore with a desi wrestling (pehelwan, dangal) theme. The tagline "Dil se Khan, pait se pehelwan." sits under the logo on every page.
2. Tone: loud and funny like a dangal announcer, in English with short Roman Urdu phrases. Buttons say exactly what they do ("Add to order").
3. Colours, only these: Khan Red #D62828, Charcoal #1A1A1A, Cream #FFF4E0, Turmeric #F4A300. No gradients or soft shadows: use hard Charcoal offset shadows.
4. Fonts from Google Fonts: "Bebas Neue" for huge headings, "Poppins" for body text.
5. Every page looks like a hand-painted dangal fight poster: thick Charcoal outlines, halftone dots, starburst badges, slightly tilted panels, oversized stacked headings. No small all-caps labels above headings, no rows of identical rounded cards.
6. The home page hero is a fight card, "Pehelwan Stack vs Your Bhook", and the page's one big entrance: on load the words slam in with a screen shake.
7. Motion answers the visitor: buttons wobble on hover and squash on click, a clicked menu item bursts "DHISHOOM!" and joins the order, a wrong form field shakes, a placed order fires burger-emoji confetti.
8. Every page has a Charcoal header with "BURGERKHAN", the tagline and links to every page, and a footer with "@burgerkhan.pk", "Lahore" and "Akhaaray mein utro: DM @burgerkhan.pk aur abhi order karo."
9. Prices are written "Rs 1,099", never in capitals, PKR or "/-". The Pehelwan Stack (triple smash patty, double cheese, Khan sauce, fries) is Rs 1,099 with a "Champion" belt badge.
10. Phone numbers are 11 digits starting with 03, shown as 0300-1234567, checked before a form submits, with a red error saying how to fix it.
11. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in the main folder, no libraries, index.html as home. Works on a 375 px phone, shows keyboard focus, stops animation for prefers-reduced-motion.
12. Never use stock photos or outside images: use emoji, CSS shapes and SVG.
13. The background is never static: behind the hero, poster sunburst rays rotate slowly; across the page, halftone dots drift diagonally and faint burger, chilli and 💪 emoji float upward at different speeds.
14. The site is "BurgerKhan Fight Night": sections are rounds of a live dangal, introduced with a round card and a bell.
